_how_to_edit: Edit any text below, then run: node linux-store/marketing/render.mjs  ·  Wrap words in *stars* to colour them lime  ·  Type \n for a manual line break  ·  Set a value to "" to hide that element. Image paths are relative to linux-store/marketing/.

_offer_sources.code: theme/templates/index.json → marquee block m1 code = LINUX10 (also the default of the cart-drawer discount chip). Make sure the code exists in Shopify → Discounts before posting.
_offer_sources.code_value: locales home.newsletter_body / newsletter.footer_label → 10% off your first order
_offer_sources.free_delivery: config/settings_data.json free_shipping_threshold = 2000 (LE) · locales home.marquee_1, sections.hero.trust_1, cart.offer_bar
_offer_sources.customize: locales customize.print_note (print from a single piece) and customize.min_embroidery (embroidery minimum) · index.customize.json min_embroidery = 10
_offer_sources.price: dev/data/product-hoodie-sada-*.json price 64900 = LE 649 (catalog snapshot; confirm the live price, or set price to "")
